# opnsense_acmeclient_validation (Data Source)

ACME challenge types (**Services ▸ ACME Client ▸ Challenge Types**, plugin `os-acme-client`): HTTP-01, TLS-ALPN-01 or DNS-01 with one of the acme.sh DNS providers. Only the attributes of the chosen `dns_service` are used.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the ACME challenge type.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description for this validation.
- `dns_1984hosting_password` (String, Sensitive) API Password.
- `dns_1984hosting_totp_secret` (String, Sensitive) When 2FA is enabled, the Base32 TOTP secret must be provided. Note that this feature requires the package oath-toolkit, which must be installed manually.
- `dns_1984hosting_user` (String) API User.
- `dns_acmedns_baseurl` (String) Specify the custom ACME DNS URL, i.e. https://auth.acme-dns.io:443 (optional).
- `dns_acmedns_password` (String, Sensitive) Password.
- `dns_acmedns_subdomain` (String) Subdomain.
- `dns_acmedns_updateurl` (String) dns_acmedns_updateurl.
- `dns_acmedns_user` (String) User.
- `dns_acmeproxy_endpoint` (String) Specify the acmeproxy endpoint URL, i.e. https://acmeproxy.example.com/.

- `dns_acmeproxy_username` (String) User.

Defaults to 0 seconds, which causes Acme Client to check public DNS services every 10 seconds for up to 20 minutes. If set to a non-zero value, a fixed DNS sleep time will be used and the local DNS servers will be queried instead. A DNS sleep time of 120 seconds or more is recommended for some DNS APIs.

- `dns_zone_key` (String, Sensitive) Can be generated under ZoneID account management.
- `dns_zone_username` (String) Zone Username.
- `dns_zoneedit_id` (String) ZoneEdit ID.
- `dns_zoneedit_token` (String, Sensitive) ZoneEdit Token.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable this validation.
- `http_haproxy_frontends` (Set of String) Choose the local HAProxy frontends. They will automatically be configured to redirect acme challenges to the internal acme client. The HAProxy service will automatically be restarted if a certificate was renewed.
- `http_haproxy_inject` (Boolean) Automatically inject config into the local HAProxy instance to let it serve acme challanges without service interruption. Of course, adding the configuration requires a short restart of the HAProxy service.
- `http_opn_autodiscovery` (Boolean) The FQDN's used in your certificate must currently point to an official IP address. Choose this option to let OPNsense try to auto-discover these IP addresses. This will lead to a short downtime of the service that is normally used with this IP address.NOTE:This will ONLY work if the official IP addresses are LOCALLY configured on your OPNsense firewall.
- `http_opn_interface` (String) The FQDN's used in your certificate must currently point to an official IP address. Choose the interface where this IP address is currently configured. OPNsense will automatically create a temporary port forward to allow the ACME validation to succeed. This will lead to a short downtime of the service that is normally used with this IP address.NOTE:This will ONLY work if the official IP addresses are LOCALLY configured on your OPNsense firewall.
- `http_opn_ipaddresses` (Set of String) The FQDN's used in your certificate must currently point to one or more official IP addresses. Enter the all of these IP addresses here. OPNsense will automatically create a temporary port forward to allow the ACME validation to succeed. This will lead to a short downtime of the service that is normally used with these IP addresses.NOTE:This will ONLY work if the official IP addresses are LOCALLY configured on your OPNsense firewall.
- `http_service` (String) HTTP Service. One of `opnsense`, `haproxy`.
- `method` (String) Set the ACME challenge type. You'll have to add configuration for the selected challenge type below. One of `http01`, `dns01`, `tlsalpn01`.
- `name` (String) Name to identify this validation.
- `tlsalpn_acme_autodiscovery` (Boolean) The FQDN's used in your certificate must currently point to an official IP address. Choose this option to let OPNsense try to auto-discover these IP addresses. This will lead to a short downtime of the service that is normally used with this IP address.NOTE:This will ONLY work if the official IP addresses are LOCALLY configured on your OPNsense firewall.
- `tlsalpn_acme_interface` (String) The FQDN's used in your certificate must currently point to an official IP address. Choose the interface where this IP address is currently configured. OPNsense will automatically create a temporary port forward to allow the ACME validation to succeed. This will lead to a short downtime of the service that is normally used with this IP address.NOTE:This will ONLY work if the official IP addresses are LOCALLY configured on your OPNsense firewall.
- `tlsalpn_acme_ipaddresses` (Set of String) The FQDN's used in your certificate must currently point to one or more official IP addresses. Enter the all of these IP addresses here. OPNsense will automatically create a temporary port forward to allow the ACME validation to succeed. This will lead to a short downtime of the service that is normally used with these IP addresses.NOTE:This will ONLY work if the official IP addresses are LOCALLY configured on your OPNsense firewall.
- `tlsalpn_service` (String) TLS-ALPN Service. One of `acme`.
